import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    idx = 0
    qtty = data[idx]
    idx += 1

    shts = data[idx:idx + qtty]
    idx += qtty

    ts = data[idx]

    shts.sort()

    maxspan = 0
    n = len(shts)

    for i in range(n):
        lo = i + 1
        hi = n

        while lo < hi:
            mid = lo + (hi - lo) // 2
            if shts[mid] - shts[i] <= ts:
                lo = mid + 1
            else:
                hi = mid

        cur = lo - i
        if cur > maxspan:
            maxspan = cur

    sys.stdout.write(str(maxspan) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
